Name: Floral Taxonomy
Author: MCXVS
Description:
[center][/center][center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/9p7to0m.png[/img]﻿[/center]

This was made as an entry for the Stardew Valley Discord Spring 2020 Event Modding Mini Contest.

This simple [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] mod will change your flower names to their scientific counterparts. You can enable the changes for the crops/objects and the seeds separately.

A document will be attached if you want to check out what names have changed. Open with your text editor of choice.


[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/keW1EAR.png[/img][/center]
[b]FlowersEnabled[/b] : Enables the name change for the flowers themselves (that means the crop), boolean (default: true)

[b]SeedsEnabled [/b]: Enables the name change for the flower's seeds, boolean (default: true)



[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/QKb0gx0.png[/img]﻿[/center]
For now, the mod currently supports the vanilla flowers and the ones from the following mods:

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598]Fruits and Veggies[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671]More Trees[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2028]Mizu's Flowers[/url]﻿
[/list]
About [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2075]Farmer to Florist[/url]﻿ :

Since the PPJA team only has partial ownership of the mod and Kildren (the original mod author) hasn't explicitly stated what can and cannot be done to his mod, I can't change the names of F2F's flowers, not without Kildren's permission. I have messaged him on the Chucklefish forums but since he left the Stardew community a while ago, it is unlikely that I get a response in the near future. If I do get a positive response or if the PPJA team gets full permission for the mod, I will of course add it to the list. For now, it isn't supported.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/1oNZ322.png[/img]﻿[/center]
Install like a regular [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] mod: Drag and drop the folder named "[CP] Floral Taxonomy" in your Stardew "Mods" folder.
In case of update, delete first.
